title: fix: keep generated API docs complete
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix the custom managed-agent request schema that crashes Enter OpenAPI generation
- Fail the merged docs schema when the required account schema is unavailable
- Require account, community-model, and agent paths before generating APIDOCS.md
- Include OpenAPI tag prose in generated Markdown and clarify App Key usage
- Add regression coverage for agent routes and partial-schema failures

Tests:
- enter.pollinations.ai: docs redirect + prompt agent runtime (22 passed)
- gen.pollinations.ai: docs routes (7 passed)

gist.headline: The docs grew their missing limbs
gist.blurb: The API garden is producing complete field guides again. Agent routes, account schemas, and the useful prose between endpoints now make it into the generated docs.
gist.summary: Fixed OpenAPI-to-APIDOCS generation by repairing the managed-agent request schema, failing safely when the required account schema is missing, requiring account/community-model/agent paths, and carrying OpenAPI tag descriptions into Markdown.
gist.impact: Developers now get complete generated API docs for account, community-model, and agent routes instead of quietly receiving partial documentation when a required schema is unavailable.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a cozy documentation garden where complete API pages grow as sturdy code-plants; a CRT monitor robot carefully assembles labeled route cards for Account, Community Models, and Agents, while a previously incomplete page is repaired with missing puzzle pieces. The scene represents schema validation preventing partial docs and richer tag prose becoming readable guides.
